values.note: 12 full-hookup sites (1-6, 8, 10, 12, 28, 30, 32; site 6 accessible) and 18 standard sites; three camper cabins on sites 7, 9 and 11; four walk-in group tent sites. One RV and one tent per site, six people.

sites.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/cliffs-neuse-state-park/camping ('There are 12 sites with full RV hookups ... There are also 18 standard campsites', 'Camper cabins are located on sites 7, 9, and 11', 'a limit of one RV and one tent'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Bathhouse with toilets and hot showers; dump station between sites 19 and 21; firewood at the visitor center or camp store.

facilities.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/cliffs-neuse-state-park/camping ('The campground has a bathhouse with toilets and hot showers available to all campers. season.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/cliffs-neuse-state-park/camping ('The family campground at Cliffs of the Neuse State Park is located in a wooded area near the park office and is open year-round') + ReserveAmerica ('Status: Open year round'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booking page: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance.' note: Wooded family campground near the park office, in a park on 90-ft bluffs over the Neuse River with an 11-acre swim lake (swim lake and boat rentals closed for the 2026 season). --Claude
summary: Changed site count 35 -> 30 (12 full-hookup + 18 standard; plus 3 camper cabins). Confirmed 30/50-amp full hookups, showers, dump station, year-round, ReserveAmerica booking. Added drinking water, 6-month window, 1-day-ahead cutoff (overrides the agency's same-day 9 p.m.), holiday 2-night minimum waived within 14 days. Fees ($30 / $45 incl. the $3 nightly reservation fee; RA rate table $27 non-electric, $42 electric for 2026-27) stand. Park: swim lake and boat rentals closed for 2026, campground open. Not stated: site lengths, pull-throughs, fcfs, max stay (left inherited).
